# `contest`

A comparison of two numbers with chance: their difference or log-ratio, scaled, with logistic noise of a given spread (07 §4.1).

Defaults that `scale` and `add` act on when a definition leaves the field out (04 §6.1): `factor` 1, `spread` 1, `near` 0.

## Fields

Besides these, a definition takes the [keys every definition carries](README.md#keys-every-definition-carries).

- `name` ([text](../values.md#texts), or `null`; optional): What a reader calls it.
- `form` (one of `"difference"`, `"ratio"` ([`ContestForm`](#contestform)); optional): What is compared.
- `factor` (number; default `1`): What the comparison is multiplied by.
- `spread` (number; default `1`): The scale of the noise added to the comparison.
- `near` (number; default `0`): How far below zero a margin of aim may be and still land beside the part aimed at (07 §4.2).

<a id="contestform"></a>
### `ContestForm`

What a contest compares (07 §4.1).

One of:

- `"difference"`: The difference of the two values, scaled.
- `"ratio"`: The natural logarithm of their ratio, scaled: what matters is how many times one is the other.
